purpose: Independent practice of C3.2 (read code and predict).
student_learning_goal: I can read code and predict what will happen when it runs.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can read code and predict what will happen when it runs.
header.character_watermark: Coda in the top-right corner with a thought bubble. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Read each code. Mark Coda's ending position on the grid.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Six small 5x5 grid maps in a 2x3 arrangement, each with code text and a grid for marking position.

image_placeholders.description: Six small 5x5 grid maps in B&W line-art, 2-row × 3-column. Each ~2in × 2in. Each shows code text plus the grid for marking.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_SIX_GRIDS: keywords (grid, predict) name what the maps ask for.

parts.answer_key: Each ending position depends on the specific code given.

parts.student_instructions: Read each code. Predict the shape it draws.

image_placeholders.description: Four shape-prediction boxes in B&W line-art, 2-row × 2-column grid. Each ~3.5in × 2in. Code text on left, blank shape drawing area on right. Codes: Repeat 4: forward, turn (square); Repeat 3: forward, turn (triangle); Repeat 5: forward, turn (pentagon); Repeat 6: forward, turn (hexagon).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_FOUR_SHAPES: keywords (shape, predict) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Read this code with a loop. Predict where Coda ends.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom. A code box and a blank grid.

image_placeholders.description: A code box and prediction grid in B&W line-art, ~7in × 3in. Code: 'Repeat 2: right, up'. Coda starts at (0,0). Blank 5x5 grid for marking the ending position.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_LOOP_PREDICT: keywords (loop, predict) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Repeat 2: right, up = (1,1) → (2,2). Coda ends at (2,2).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a 4-step code of your own and predict the outcome.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Watch Part 1 children who count steps without tracking direction — flag for direction-aware reading reteach. Part 3 is a TRANSFER probe: present a code with a NESTED instruction or 6+ steps combining sequence + loop, and ask the child to JUSTIFY their prediction in one sentence ('I predict (3,2) because the loop runs twice, each time moving Coda forward 1 then up 1').
